name: JNE
summary: JNE develops a low-background neutrino programme at the deeply shielded China Jinping Underground Laboratory. Its upgraded one-tonne prototype has operated with water and liquid scintillator at CJPL-I, while a larger detector is under construction for solar, geoneutrino and astrophysical measurements.
detection_principle: Scintillation and Cherenkov light in an optically instrumented target are studied to combine low thresholds and directionality. Deep rock shielding and distance from coastal nuclear reactors favour solar and terrestrial-neutrino measurements.

status.label: Prototype operation and larger-detector construction
status.evidence: The September 2026 collaboration paper documents completed upgraded-prototype runs and explicitly identifies the larger JNE detector as under construction.

phases.name: Larger JNE detector
phases.description: The 2026 collaboration publication identifies the larger detector as under construction; a full-scale solar-neutrino measurement is not claimed.

results.summary: The upgraded prototype demonstrated water and liquid-scintillator operating modes and muon reconstruction. This is detector R&D, not a completed full-scale solar or geoneutrino measurement.
